'''Patrizia M. Gianni''' (born 1952){{r|born}} is an Italian mathematician specializing in [[computer algebra]]. She is known for her early research on [[Gröbner basis|Gröbner bases]] including her discovery of the [[FGLM algorithm]] for changing monomial orderings in Gröbner bases,{{r|mora}} and for her development of the components of the [[Axiom (computer algebra system)|Axiom computer algebra system]] concerning [[polynomial]]s and [[rational function]]s.{{r|axiom}}

Gianni is a professor of algebra in the mathematics department of the [[University of Pisa]].{{r|unipi}} She earned a [[laurea]] from the University of Pisa,{{r|axiom}} and has worked for [[IBM Research]] as well as for the University of Pisa.{{r|acm}}
